import { RoomCore } from '/tmp/v2src/src/shared/room';
import { writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';
const out = process.argv[2];
mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });
let n = 0;
const id = () => `00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000${(10 + n++)}`;
function dump(name: string, c: RoomCore) {
  writeFileSync(`${out}/${name}.room.json`, JSON.stringify(c.room));
  if (c.game) writeFileSync(`${out}/${name}.game.json`, JSON.stringify(c.game));
}
// lobby: one human joined, no game
const lobby = new RoomCore('LEGA', 123456789);
lobby.join(null, 'Ada', id);
dump('lobby', lobby);
// running match: host starts, 200 ticks of real-time play
const run = new RoomCore('LEGB', 987654321);
const j = run.join(null, 'Ada', id);
run.handle(j.playerId, { t: 'start' } as any);
for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) run.step();
console.log(run.room.status, (run.game as any).tick);
dump('running', run);
